name: Master and detail
descriptor: Two lists with a pointer: a parent record, and the children that name it. The read view of a parent lists its children.
verify_checks: relation: the lookup select is emitted
relation: a child is listed under its parent
pros: the parent read view becomes the place you work, not a list to scroll
the pointer is stored as an id, so renaming a parent does not break it
each list keeps its own fields, its own form and its own search
one file, one export, both lists
cons: one level only: a child cannot have children
no cascade: deleting a parent leaves its children pointing at nothing
a lookup is a select, so it does not scale past a few hundred parents
best_for: a parent and its children, read and edited together
avoid_if: the nesting is deeper than one level, or parents number in the thousands
